Enemy appearance mn_ff3_096_c01.ja: 三つ首の猟犬が爪のある足で低くうずくまる。長い首の先の頭には尖った耳と、歯をむき出しにした開いた鼻面がある。幅広い背の後ろで尾が巻き上がる。金色の体に青緑の足指と赤い縞。

Enemy appearance mn_ff3_097_c00.en: A low, heavy dragon body supports two very long pointed heads on sloping necks. A ridge of spines follows the back, small webbed wings lift from the body, and a thick tail curves behind. It has yellow-gold scales, magenta spines and blue claws.
Enemy appearance mn_ff3_097_c00.ja: 地面近くの重い竜の胴に、斜めの首を持つ非常に長く尖った頭が二つ乗る。背に一列の棘があり、小さな膜状の翼が体から上がり、太い尾が後ろで曲がる。黄金色の鱗に赤紫の棘と青い爪。

Enemy appearance mn_ff3_097_c01.en: A low, heavy dragon body supports two very long pointed heads on sloping necks. A ridge of spines follows the back, small webbed wings lift from the body, and a thick tail curves behind. It is dark teal with green spines and orange claws.
Enemy appearance mn_ff3_097_c01.ja: 地面近くの重い竜の胴に、斜めの首を持つ非常に長く尖った頭が二つ乗る。背に一列の棘があり、小さな膜状の翼が体から上がり、太い尾が後ろで曲がる。濃い青緑の体に緑の棘と橙の爪。

Enemy appearance mn_ff3_098_c00.en: A luminous green humanoid figure curls forward inside twists of red and gold organic strands. Long sharp fingers, red eyes and flowing green hair stand out above a tapering lower body. Smaller tendrils and orb-shaped tips curl outward around it.
Enemy appearance mn_ff3_098_c00.ja: 光る緑色の人型が、赤と金の生き物のような帯の渦の中で前へかがむ。先細りの下半身の上に長く鋭い指、赤い目、流れる緑の髪が目立つ。小さな触手や球状の先端が周囲に巻き出る。

Enemy appearance mn_ff3_099_c00.en: A broad plantlike body has a large horned central head and stout arms that split into curling roots and strands. Its legs taper into long tendrils. It is blue and violet with pale cyan highlights.
Enemy appearance mn_ff3_099_c00.ja: 幅広い植物のような体に、角のある大きな中央の頭と、巻いた根や帯に分かれる太い腕がある。脚は細長い触手に変わる。青紫の体に淡い水色の光沢。

Enemy appearance mn_ff3_099_c01.en: A broad plantlike body has a large horned central head and stout arms that split into curling roots and strands. Its legs taper into long tendrils. It is orange-red with green and yellow strands.
Enemy appearance mn_ff3_099_c01.ja: 幅広い植物のような体に、角のある大きな中央の頭と、巻いた根や帯に分かれる太い腕がある。脚は細長い触手に変わる。赤橙色の体に緑と黄色の帯。

Enemy appearance mn_ff3_100_c00.en: A slender horned flying beast extends wide membranous wings over long legs, pointed feet and a long curling tail. Its narrow head juts forward below an angular horn. It has red-pink skin, turquoise wings and gold accents.
Enemy appearance mn_ff3_100_c00.ja: 細身で角のある空飛ぶ獣が、長い脚と尖った足、長く巻いた尾の上に幅広い膜状の翼を伸ばす。角張った角の下で細い頭が前に突き出る。赤桃色の体に青緑の翼と金の差し色。

Enemy appearance mn_ff3_100_c01.en: A slender horned flying beast extends wide membranous wings over long legs, pointed feet and a long curling tail. Its narrow head juts forward below an angular horn. It has dark violet-blue skin, teal wings and gold accents.
Enemy appearance mn_ff3_100_c01.ja: 細身で角のある空飛ぶ獣が、長い脚と尖った足、長く巻いた尾の上に幅広い膜状の翼を伸ばす。角張った角の下で細い頭が前に突き出る。濃い青紫の体に青緑の翼と金の差し色。

Enemy appearance mn_ff3_101_c00.en: Three coins float at different angles among small star-shaped glints. One face has an embossed design while other coins show their ridged edges. It uses pale green metal and orange-white glints.
Enemy appearance mn_ff3_101_c00.ja: 三枚の硬貨が、小さな星状のきらめきの中でそれぞれ違う角度で浮く。一枚は表に浮き彫りがあり、他からは筋のある側面が見える。淡緑色の金属に橙白の光。

Enemy appearance mn_ff3_101_c01.en: Three coins float at different angles among small star-shaped glints. One face has an embossed design while other coins show their ridged edges. It uses gold metal and violet-white glints.
Enemy appearance mn_ff3_101_c01.ja: 三枚の硬貨が、小さな星状のきらめきの中でそれぞれ違う角度で浮く。一枚は表に浮き彫りがあり、他からは筋のある側面が見える。金色の金属に紫白の光。

Enemy appearance mn_ff3_102_c00.en: A bird with upraised purple wings and golden flight feathers flies with orange talons extended. Red-orange and yellow tail feathers spread below, with two small blue tips.
Enemy appearance mn_ff3_102_c00.ja: 紫の翼を高く上げる鳥が、橙の鉤爪を伸ばして飛ぶ。風切羽は金色。赤橙と黄の尾羽が下に広がり、小さな青い先端が二本ある。

Enemy appearance mn_ff3_103_c00.en: A long purple and teal sea serpent twists into several coils beneath a narrow horned head. Long ridged fins fan back from its neck and body. The jaws are open and show white teeth, while red and copper scales mark the underside.
Enemy appearance mn_ff3_103_c00.ja: 紫と青緑の長い海蛇が、細い角付きの頭の下で幾重にも体を巻く。筋の入った長いひれが首と体から後ろへ扇状に開く。あごを開いて白い歯を見せ、下側に赤と銅色の鱗が並ぶ。

Enemy appearance mn_ff3_104_c00.en: A silver-armored rider with a horned helmet and long red cape sits on a rearing golden-brown horse. He raises a curved silver sword and carries a small round, red-and-silver patterned shield.
Enemy appearance mn_ff3_104_c00.ja: 銀の鎧の騎手が角兜と長く赤いマントを着け、立ち上がる金褐色の馬にまたがる。曲がった銀の剣を掲げ、小さな丸い盾には赤と銀の模様がある。

Enemy appearance mn_ff3_105_c00.en: A squat, hunched reptilian body has a long banded crest or tail curved overhead. A prominent pale eye, short legs and sharp yellow teeth show around a lowered jaw. It is violet with orange bands.
Enemy appearance mn_ff3_105_c00.ja: ずんぐりして身をかがめた爬虫類。縞のある長い冠か尾が頭上で曲がる。垂れたあごの周りに目立つ淡色の目、短い脚、黄色く鋭い歯が見える。紫の体に橙の帯。

Enemy appearance mn_ff3_105_c01.en: A squat, hunched reptilian body has a long banded crest or tail curved overhead. A prominent pale eye, short legs and sharp yellow teeth show around a lowered jaw. It is green with yellow-gold bands and red accents near the eyes.
Enemy appearance mn_ff3_105_c01.ja: ずんぐりして身をかがめた爬虫類。縞のある長い冠か尾が頭上で曲がる。垂れたあごの周りに目立つ淡色の目、短い脚、黄色く鋭い歯が見える。緑の体に黄金色の帯と目元の赤い模様。

Enemy appearance mn_ff3_106_c00.en: A heavy upright bear with rounded ears snarls through bared teeth and thick neck fur. It bends at the knees with wide clawed paws raised in front. It is ochre brown with green claw tips.
Enemy appearance mn_ff3_106_c00.ja: 重そうな直立する熊。丸い耳と首の厚い毛があり、歯をむき出しにして唸る。膝を曲げ、爪のある幅広い両前足を前に上げる。黄土がかった茶の体に緑の爪先。

Enemy appearance mn_ff3_106_c01.en: A heavy upright bear with rounded ears snarls through bared teeth and thick neck fur. It bends at the knees with wide clawed paws raised in front. It is copper-red with green claw and mouth accents.
Enemy appearance mn_ff3_106_c01.ja: 重そうな直立する熊。丸い耳と首の厚い毛があり、歯をむき出しにして唸る。膝を曲げ、爪のある幅広い両前足を前に上げる。銅赤色の体に緑の爪と口元。

Enemy appearance mn_ff3_107_c00.en: A long thin creature curves in an S shape, with narrow raised arms, two long lower limbs and thin branching points around its head and torso. Small glowing strands and particles hang above it. It is bright green with orange tips.
Enemy appearance mn_ff3_107_c00.ja: 長く細い生き物がＳ字に曲がる。細い両腕を上げ、下に長い手足が二本あり、頭や胴の周りに細い枝状の突起が伸びる。小さな光の筋や粒が頭上に垂れる。鮮緑の体に橙の先端。

Enemy appearance mn_ff3_107_c01.en: A long thin creature curves in an S shape, with narrow raised arms, two long lower limbs and thin branching points around its head and torso. Small glowing strands and particles hang above it. It is violet and blue with orange-gold tips.
Enemy appearance mn_ff3_107_c01.ja: 長く細い生き物がＳ字に曲がる。細い両腕を上げ、下に長い手足が二本あり、頭や胴の周りに細い枝状の突起が伸びる。小さな光の筋や粒が頭上に垂れる。青紫の体に金橙の先端。

Enemy appearance mn_ff3_108_c00.en: A winged green creature lifts enormous orange-gold feathered wings. A red crest rises from the angular head, and slender limbs and talons spread below its body. Long red and gold strands curl down at one side.
Enemy appearance mn_ff3_108_c00.ja: 緑色の翼のある生き物が、橙金色の巨大な羽毛の翼を高く上げる。角張った頭に赤い冠羽が立ち、体の下に細い手足と鉤爪を広げる。片側に赤と金の長い帯が巻き下がる。

Enemy appearance mn_ff3_109_c00.en: A compact purple-hooded figure with glowing red eyes in a dark face opening holds bent hands in front. The long pointed hood and layered tattered hem sweep backward, with gold details at the hands and waist.
Enemy appearance mn_ff3_109_c00.ja: 紫の頭巾をかぶった小柄な人物。暗い顔の開口部に赤い目が光り、曲げた両手を体の前に置く。長く尖った頭巾と、層のあるぼろぼろの裾が後ろへ流れ、手と腰に金の飾りがある。

Enemy appearance mn_ff3_110_c00.en: A round amber creature has one large violet central eye and a wide grin filled with pale pointed teeth. High horns curve around the eyes, long green bat wings spread on either side, and small clawed limbs and a violet tail hang below.
Enemy appearance mn_ff3_110_c00.ja: 琥珀色の丸い生き物に紫の大きな一つ目と、淡く尖った歯が並ぶ幅広い笑い口がある。高い角が目の周りで曲がり、左右に長い緑のコウモリ翼が広がる。小さな爪の手足と紫の尾が下がる。

Field appearance mo_ff3_b002_c00.en: A long, pointed faceted crystal has black angular edges and a luminous electric-blue interior.
Field appearance mo_ff3_b002_c00.ja: 細長く尖った多面の水晶。角張った黒い縁の中に鮮やかな青の光がある。

Field appearance mo_ff3_b004_c00.en: A long, pointed faceted crystal has black angular edges and a luminous violet interior.
Field appearance mo_ff3_b004_c00.ja: 細長く尖った多面の水晶。角張った黒い縁の中に紫の光がある。

Field appearance mo_ff3_b034_c00.en: A short horizontal cream bar has a black outline.
Field appearance mo_ff3_b034_c00.ja: 横に短いクリーム色の棒を黒い線が囲む。

Field appearance mo_ff3_b049_c00.en: A nearly black irregular horizontal shadow has rounded lobes and a narrow taper at the right.
Field appearance mo_ff3_b049_c00.ja: 不規則なほぼ黒い横長の影。丸い張り出しがあり、右側が細くなる。

Field appearance mo_ff3_b053_c00.en: A little tangled ball of hanging tan and brown rootlike strands spreads outward near its base.
Field appearance mo_ff3_b053_c00.ja: 黄褐色と茶色の根のような垂れ下がる筋が、小さな絡まった塊を作り、下で広がる。

Field appearance mo_ff3_e102_c00.en: Large icy-blue serif letters read “THE END.” Existing text can convey the words.
Field appearance mo_ff3_e102_c00.ja: 氷のような青の大きなセリフ体で「THE END」と表示される。文字は既存の読み上げでも伝えられる。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n001_c00.en: A pale blond figure has a high ponytail, a blue and white headband, a fitted blue and white top and a pale cyan cape that spreads behind her.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n001_c00.ja: 色白で金髪を高い位置でポニーテールに結ぶ。青白の鉢巻きと体に沿う青白の上着、後ろへ広がる淡い水色のマントを着ける。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n002_c00.en: A tiny figure is almost concealed by a crooked yellow-brown pointed hat. A broad white beard or pale trim covers the face and a narrow brown shoe shows under the hat.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n002_c00.ja: 黄褐色の曲がった尖り帽子に小さな姿がほぼ隠れる。広い白ひげか淡い縁が顔を覆い、帽子の下から細い茶色の靴が見える。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n003_c00.en: A compact, pale figure has large swept dark-green hair and dark eyes. A long violet coat with pale front trim sits over pointed dark boots.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n003_c00.ja: 淡い顔の小柄な人物。大きく流した深緑の髪と暗い目がある。前に明るい縁取りのある長い紫の上着から、暗色の尖った長靴がのぞく。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n004_c00.en: A slim fair-haired figure has bright blue eyes and an off-shoulder pale aqua dress. Long golden hair falls over her back.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n004_c00.ja: ほっそりした金髪の人物。明るい青い目があり、肩を出した淡い青緑のドレスを着ける。長い金髪を背に垂らす。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n005_c00.en: A fair figure wears a tall gold crown with red accents, a pale fur-like collar and an orange-red flowing cape over a dark purple garment.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n005_c00.ja: 色白の人物で、赤い飾りのある高い金の冠をかぶる。濃紫の衣装に毛皮のような淡い襟と、なびく赤橙色のマントを重ねる。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n006_c00.en: A slender figure wears a tall, scarlet pointed hood. The dark face opening shows one pale band, and gold edging follows the long robe.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n006_c00.ja: 細身で高く尖った緋色の頭巾をかぶる。暗い顔の開口部に淡い帯が一筋あり、長いローブに金の縁が走る。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n007_c00.en: A short figure peers from under a pointed gold-orange hat. Pale gray hair or beard hangs around the brim and the short clothes are gray, brown and gold.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n007_c00.ja: 金橙色の尖り帽子の下から小柄な人物がのぞく。つばから淡灰色の髪かひげが垂れ、短い服は灰、茶、金色。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n008_c00.en: A bald older man has a narrow nose, long beard and a full open robe or coat. It has a white beard and blue robes.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n008_c00.ja: 禿頭の老人物。細い鼻と長いひげがあり、ゆったりしたローブか前開きの外套に身を包む。ひげは白、衣は青。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n008_c01.en: A bald older man has a narrow nose, long beard and a full open robe or coat. It has a white beard and pink robes.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n008_c01.ja: 禿頭の老人物。細い鼻と長いひげがあり、ゆったりしたローブか前開きの外套に身を包む。ひげは白、衣は桃色。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n008_c02.en: A bald older man has a narrow nose, long beard and a full open robe or coat. It has a gray beard and blue robes with gold waist trim.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n008_c02.ja: 禿頭の老人物。細い鼻と長いひげがあり、ゆったりしたローブか前開きの外套に身を包む。ひげは灰色、金の腰飾りが付いた青い衣を着ける。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n008_c03.en: A bald older man has a narrow nose, long beard and a full open robe or coat. It has a gray beard and green robes.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n008_c03.ja: 禿頭の老人物。細い鼻と長いひげがあり、ゆったりしたローブか前開きの外套に身を包む。ひげは灰色、衣は緑。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n009_c00.en: A stocky crowned ruler has a low brow and a broad pale collar. The gold crown sits atop a narrow band of visible hair. It has pink-brown hair and a long blue-violet cloak.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n009_c00.ja: がっしりした王で、眉が低く、幅広い淡色の襟を着ける。金の冠をかぶり、下から細く髪が見える。桃褐色の髪に長い青紫のマント。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n009_c01.en: A stocky crowned ruler has a low brow and a broad pale collar. The gold crown sits atop a narrow band of visible hair. It has gray-violet hair and a green cloak.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n009_c01.ja: がっしりした王で、眉が低く、幅広い淡色の襟を着ける。金の冠をかぶり、下から細く髪が見える。灰紫色の髪に緑のマント。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n010_c00.en: A short brown-haired figure wears a tall gold crown and a red robe. White diagonal bands cross its back and blue trim borders the shoulders.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n010_c00.ja: 茶髪で背の低い人物。高い金の冠と赤いローブを着ける。背に白い斜めの帯が交差し、肩は青く縁取られる。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n011_c00.en: A bald, compact figure has bright pink hair over both ears and a large pink mustache. Its dark brown and gold top rises above orange shoes.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n011_c00.ja: 小柄な禿頭の人物で、両耳の上に鮮桃色の髪があり、大きな桃色の口ひげがある。濃茶と金の上着に橙の靴。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n012_c00.en: A slim white-haired elder has a black band across the eyes, a high pale forehead and a floor-length red coat, with white hair flowing sideways behind the head.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n012_c00.ja: 細身の白髪の老人物。高く淡い額の下で黒い帯が目を覆う。床まで届く赤い上着を着け、白髪を後ろへ横に流す。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n013_c00.en: A narrow armored figure has a copper-red helm with two gold projections, gold chest and shoulder bars, and dark gloves and legs.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n013_c00.ja: 細身の鎧姿。赤銅色の兜に金の突起二本があり、胸と肩に金の帯、手袋と脚に暗い色が見える。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n014_c00.en: A bald stocky figure has a gray-black mustache and tiny dark eyes. Bare arms flank a narrow gold belt and deep purple trousers.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n014_c00.ja: 禿頭でがっしりした人物。灰黒の口ひげと小さな暗い目がある。細い金の帯と濃紫のズボンの両側に裸の腕が見える。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n015_c00.en: A small pale-faced figure has swept-up fuchsia locks or flame-shaped points, bright red eyes and full violet shoulder sleeves.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n015_c00.ja: 淡い顔の小柄な人物。鮮やかな赤紫の髪か炎のような突起が上へ流れ、目が鮮赤色で、紫の袖が肩でふくらむ。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n016_c00.en: A gray-clad humanoid has broad reddish-brown hair or fur with pointed sides. Narrow bright marks show on the dark face, red stripes cross its waist and one pale arm bends.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n016_c00.ja: 灰色の衣装の人型。横に尖った幅広い赤茶色の髪か毛がある。暗い顔に細い明るい模様、腰に赤い縞があり、淡い片腕を曲げる。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n017_c00.en: A small robed figure has a pale face below a tilted dark red and black headpiece. A pink-purple sash crosses white or gray sleeves and red trim edges the bottom.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n017_c00.ja: ローブの小柄な人物。斜めにかぶった暗赤と黒の頭飾りの下に淡い顔がある。白か灰の袖の前に桃紫の帯を渡し、裾は赤く縁取る。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n018_c00.en: A short blue hooded figure has a featureless dark oval opening, broad loose sleeves and blue folds spreading across the floor.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n018_c00.ja: 背の低い青い頭巾の人物。暗い楕円形の顔の穴には目鼻が見えず、幅広いゆったりした袖と青いひだが床に広がる。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n019_c00.en: A squat gold-armored figure wears a horned helmet over a dark face slit. A saturated magenta cape hangs behind the dark gold boots.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n019_c00.ja: 金の鎧を着けたずんぐりした人物。暗く細い顔の開口部の上に角兜があり、濃金色の長靴の後ろに鮮やかな赤紫のマントが垂れる。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n020_c00.en: A short orange-haired figure has a broad swept fringe, pale face, dark eyes and a bright green top over yellow trousers.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n020_c00.ja: 橙髪の背の低い人物。幅広い前髪を流し、淡い顔に暗い目がある。黄色いズボンの上に鮮緑の上着を着ける。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n021_c00.en: A compact figure with a jagged silver-violet head crest wears a face covering with a thin dark slit. Orange details mark the blue fitted outfit and long blue cape.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n021_c00.ja: 小柄で兜にぎざぎざの銀紫の冠飾りがあり、顔当ては暗く細い隙間だけが開く。体に沿う青い服と長い青マントに橙の飾りがある。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n022_c00.en: A thin white outline traces a person with a wide lower robe around a completely dark interior. The shape turns edge-on in profile.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n022_c00.ja: 裾の広い長衣の人影を、細い白の輪郭が描く。中は真っ暗で、横を向くと細い輪郭だけが見える。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n023_c00.en: A heavy bald figure has a bright red band over the lower face, a green coat and cape with pale trim and red framing the ears.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n023_c00.ja: 禿頭の大柄な人物。顔の下半分に鮮紅の帯を巻き、耳の周りも赤い。淡色の縁がある緑の上着とマントを着ける。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n024_c00.en: A little violet-blue creature has tall ears with vivid red interiors, a dark face with gold highlights and tiny red-tipped feet.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n024_c00.ja: 青紫色の小さな生き物。高い耳の内側は鮮赤色で、暗い顔に金の差し色があり、小さな足の先は赤い。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n025_c00.en: A small horse in profile has upright ears, a lifted foreleg, a short mane and a narrow tail. It is white and silver.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n025_c00.ja: 小さな馬の横姿。耳を立て、片前脚を上げ、たてがみが短く尾が細い。体は白と銀色。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n025_c01.en: A small horse in profile has upright ears, a lifted foreleg, a short mane and a narrow tail. It is dark gray with a pale tail.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n025_c01.ja: 小さな馬の横姿。耳を立て、片前脚を上げ、たてがみが短く尾が細い。体は濃灰色で尾は淡い。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n026_c00.en: A small bright red bird has a hooked silver beak, gold feet and folded red feathers. Its crest sweeps pointedly back.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n026_c00.ja: 鮮赤色の小鳥。鉤形の銀のくちばしと金の足があり、赤い羽をたたむ。尖った冠羽が後ろへ流れる。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n027_c00.en: A round pale base holds a narrow gray raised animal-like head with pointed ears and dark eye markings. Two purple details show at the sides.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n027_c00.ja: 淡色の丸い土台に細い灰色の動物のような頭が立ち、尖った耳と暗い目の模様がある。両脇に紫の飾りが二つ見える。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n028_c00.en: An empty dark face opening is surrounded by a dark rose hood. Long red sleeves and ragged lower folds frame the silhouette.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n028_c00.ja: 何も見えない暗い顔の開口部を濃いばら色の頭巾が囲む。長い赤い袖とぼろぼろの裾のひだが輪郭を形作る。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n029_c00.en: A small mage in a round pale-banded blue hat and broad aqua robe has yellow eyes against a black face. Pale cuffs stick out of the sleeves.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n029_c00.ja: 小柄な魔道士。淡色の帯のある丸い青帽子と、水色の幅広いローブ。黒い顔に黄色い目があり、淡い袖口が袖から突き出す。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n030_c00.en: Dense dark armor has layered shoulder plates, red visor slits and a broad swept plume. It has slate-blue armor and a salmon plume.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n030_c00.ja: 隙間の少ない暗い鎧。重なった肩甲、赤い面の切れ目、大きく流れる羽根飾りがある。青灰色の鎧にサーモン色の羽根。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n030_c01.en: Dense dark armor has layered shoulder plates, red visor slits and a broad swept plume. It has purple armor and a lime-green plume.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n030_c01.ja: 隙間の少ない暗い鎧。重なった肩甲、赤い面の切れ目、大きく流れる羽根飾りがある。紫の鎧に鮮黄緑の羽根。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n031_c00.en: A short brown-haired figure wears a turquoise scarf, a fitted teal and gold outfit, pale cuffs and teal footwear.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n031_c00.ja: 茶髪の小柄な人物。青緑のスカーフと体に沿う青緑と金の衣装、淡色の袖口、青緑の履物を着ける。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n032_c00.en: A heavily armored figure has a wide eye slit and hooked horns extending from the helmet and shoulders. It has red-orange armor with gold horns.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n032_c00.ja: 重装の人物で、目の開口部が幅広く、鉤形の角が兜や肩から伸びる。赤橙の鎧に金の角。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n032_c01.en: A heavily armored figure has a wide eye slit and hooked horns extending from the helmet and shoulders. It has muted blue plate and lilac horns.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n032_c01.ja: 重装の人物で、目の開口部が幅広く、鉤形の角が兜や肩から伸びる。くすんだ青の板金鎧に淡紫の角。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n033_c00.en: A floating green light has a white-green core and dark translucent edges. It has a round wreath of irregular wisps.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n033_c00.ja: 白緑色の中心と暗く半透明の縁を持つ、緑の浮かぶ光。不規則な薄い光が丸い輪を描く。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n033_c01.en: A floating green light has a white-green core and dark translucent edges. It has a narrow tall flame with a low round light.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n033_c01.ja: 白緑色の中心と暗く半透明の縁を持つ、緑の浮かぶ光。細く高い炎と低い丸い光がある。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n034_c00.en: A large gold bird sits with a bowed blunt head, short black-edged legs and a rounded mass of layered feathers. One frame shows a narrow gray curl beside its beak.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n034_c00.ja: 金色の大きな鳥が座り、丸い頭を下げる。短い黒縁の脚と、丸く重なった羽毛がある。ひとコマではくちばしの横に細い灰色の巻いた形が出る。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n035_c00.en: A red, crouched horned creature spreads two tall green-edged batlike wings from a tapering armored body. Clawed limbs and white eye highlights show.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n035_c00.ja: 赤く角のある生き物が身をかがめ、先細りの鎧の胴から緑縁のコウモリ状の高い翼二枚を広げる。爪のある手足と白く光る目が見える。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n036_c00.en: A small armored silhouette has a silvery faceless helmet, curved red horns and red shoulder edges. Stripes and jagged gray plates cross its chest.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n036_c00.ja: 小さな鎧姿。顔のない銀色の兜に赤い曲がった角があり、肩の縁も赤い。胸に縞とぎざぎざした灰色の板が渡る。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n037_c00.en: A little violet armored creature curls close to the ground. A green jointed silhouette frames a pink-violet body, with thin pale feelers and several pointed limbs.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n037_c00.ja: 紫の小さな鎧の生き物が地面近くに体を巻く。緑の節のある輪郭が桃紫の胴を囲み、細く淡い触角と尖った脚がいくつも突き出す。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n038_c00.en: A small upright skeletal-looking monster has a long curved gray tail, dark clawed limbs, many ribs or thin ridges and a broad pointed pale wing.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n038_c00.ja: 小さく直立する骨ばった怪物。長く曲がる灰色の尾、爪のある暗い手足、たくさんの肋骨か細い筋と幅広く尖った淡色の翼がある。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n116_c00.ja: 長い冠羽を持つ小鳥。曲がったくちばしと大きな目、短い指の付いた丈の高い脚がある。黄色い羽に橙のくちばしと脚。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n116_c01.en: A small long-crested bird has a curved bill, large eye and tall short-toed feet. It has bright pink feathers, a pale eye surround and deep blue and yellow feet.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n116_c01.ja: 長い冠羽を持つ小鳥。曲がったくちばしと大きな目、短い指の付いた丈の高い脚がある。鮮桃色の羽、目の周りが淡く、足は濃青と黄。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n118_c00.en: A tiny mage has a dark face, bright yellow eyes, a broad pointed hat and a flaring cloak. It wears a pale orange hat with a teal cloak.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n118_c00.ja: 小さな魔道士。暗い顔に明るい黄色の目があり、幅広い尖り帽子と裾の広い外套を着ける。淡橙の帽子と青緑の外套。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n118_c01.en: A tiny mage has a dark face, bright yellow eyes, a broad pointed hat and a flaring cloak. It wears an ochre hat and cyan-blue cloak.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n118_c01.ja: 小さな魔道士。暗い顔に明るい黄色の目があり、幅広い尖り帽子と裾の広い外套を着ける。黄土色の帽子と水色の外套。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n118_c02.en: A tiny mage has a dark face, bright yellow eyes, a broad pointed hat and a flaring cloak. It wears a salmon hat with a vivid blue cloak.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n118_c02.ja: 小さな魔道士。暗い顔に明るい黄色の目があり、幅広い尖り帽子と裾の広い外套を着ける。サーモン色の帽子と鮮青の外套。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n118_c03.en: A tiny mage has a dark face, bright yellow eyes, a broad pointed hat and a flaring cloak. It has a yellow-green hat and violet cloak.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n118_c03.ja: 小さな魔道士。暗い顔に明るい黄色の目があり、幅広い尖り帽子と裾の広い外套を着ける。黄緑の帽子と紫の外套。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n119_c00.en: A plump white moogle has pointed ears, a small pink nose, tiny closed-looking eyes and short pale feet. It has violet batlike wings.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n119_c00.ja: ふっくらした白いモーグリ。尖った耳に小さな桃色の鼻、閉じたような小さな目、短い淡色の足がある。紫のコウモリ状の翼。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n119_c01.en: A plump white moogle has pointed ears, a small pink nose, tiny closed-looking eyes and short pale feet. It has red-orange wings.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n119_c01.ja: ふっくらした白いモーグリ。尖った耳に小さな桃色の鼻、閉じたような小さな目、短い淡色の足がある。赤橙色の翼。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n120_c00.en: A tiny green frog has a bright yellow face patch, raised eyes and a little bent body with short splayed limbs.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n120_c00.ja: 小さな緑のカエル。顔に鮮黄色の模様と突き出た目があり、小さく曲げた体から短い脚を広げる。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n121_c00.en: A woolly cream ram has dark curled horns, a blunt pink nose, small black eyes and short pale legs.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n121_c00.ja: クリーム色の羊毛を持つ雄羊。巻いた暗い角、丸い桃色の鼻、小さな黒い目と短い淡色の脚がある。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n122_c00.en: A very small person has simple short hair or cap, a round pale face, a blocky top and tiny brown feet. It has yellow hair and green clothing.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n122_c00.ja: ごく小さな人物。簡素な短髪か帽子、丸く淡い顔、角張った上着、小さな茶色の足がある。黄色い髪に緑の服。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n122_c01.en: A very small person has simple short hair or cap, a round pale face, a blocky top and tiny brown feet. It is pale violet and blue.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n122_c01.ja: ごく小さな人物。簡素な短髪か帽子、丸く淡い顔、角張った上着、小さな茶色の足がある。淡い紫と青の色合い。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n122_c02.en: A very small person has simple short hair or cap, a round pale face, a blocky top and tiny brown feet. It has brown hair and a red top.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n122_c02.ja: ごく小さな人物。簡素な短髪か帽子、丸く淡い顔、角張った上着、小さな茶色の足がある。茶色の髪に赤い上着。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n123_c00.en: A tiny robed figure wears a broad feathered magenta hat and a matching robe with a pale shoulder drape and gold hem.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n123_c00.ja: 小さなローブ姿の人物。羽根のある幅広い赤紫の帽子をかぶり、同じ色のローブに淡色の肩掛けと金の裾がある。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n124_c00.en: A slim pale figure has long pointed hair under a horned band and a short fitted tunic. It uses golden-brown hair and teal details.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n124_c00.ja: 淡い顔の細身の人物。角のある鉢巻きの下に長く尖った髪があり、体に沿った短い上着を着ける。金褐色の髪に青緑の模様。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n124_c01.en: A slim pale figure has long pointed hair under a horned band and a short fitted tunic. It uses dusky rose hair and pale blue details.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n124_c01.ja: 淡い顔の細身の人物。角のある鉢巻きの下に長く尖った髪があり、体に沿った短い上着を着ける。くすんだばら色の髪に淡青の模様。

Field appearance mo_ff3_n125_c00.en: A white hood and robe nearly cover the figure. A red band frames the shadowed eyes, and a narrow magenta border runs along the hem.
Field appearance mo_ff3_n125_c00.ja: 白い頭巾とローブが人物のほとんどを覆う。影の中の目を赤い帯が囲み、裾には赤紫の細い縁が走る。

Field appearance mo_ff3_p001_c00.en: A swept brown fringe frames a pale face above red armor with pale wrist and shoulder trim.
Field appearance mo_ff3_p001_c00.ja: 流した茶の前髪が淡い顔を囲む。赤い鎧に淡色の手首と肩の飾りが付く。

Field appearance mo_ff3_p002_c00.en: A pale figure wears a green hood and short green tunic with pale sleeve bands and golden leg wraps.
Field appearance mo_ff3_p002_c00.ja: 淡い顔に緑の頭巾。淡い袖帯の付いた短い緑の上着に、金色の脚の巻き布を着ける。

Field appearance mo_ff3_p003_c00.en: An athletic figure has short brown hair, a narrow blue headband and an olive-tan sleeveless outfit. A blue sash and wraps edge the exposed arms and legs.
Field appearance mo_ff3_p003_c00.ja: 引き締まった体に短い茶髪、細い青の鉢巻き、オリーブがかった薄茶の袖なし服。青い帯や巻き布がむき出しの手足を縁取る。

Field appearance mo_ff3_p004_c00.en: A pale white-haired face sits under a broad red hat with white trim.
Field appearance mo_ff3_p004_c00.ja: 白髪の淡い顔が、白い縁のある幅広の赤帽子の下にある。

Field appearance mo_ff3_p005_c00.en: A young brown-haired face peeks out of a broad white hood. A red border runs along the field robe's hem. Battle frames show repeated red triangles and a wide flaring white cape.
Field appearance mo_ff3_p005_c00.ja: 大きな白い頭巾から茶髪の若い顔がのぞく。野外のローブは裾に赤い縁があり、戦闘では赤い三角模様が並んだ広い白のマントが広がる。

Field appearance mo_ff3_p006_c00.en: A mustard pointed hat covers a dark face with tiny yellow eyes. A deep blue loose robe and pale wrists show below.
Field appearance mo_ff3_p006_c00.ja: からし色の尖り帽子の下の暗い顔に黄色い小さな目がある。ゆったりした濃青のローブと淡い手首が下に見える。

Field appearance mo_ff3_p007_c00.en: A stocky brown-haired figure wears pale metal head and shoulder bands and a red cape.
Field appearance mo_ff3_p007_c00.ja: 茶髪のずんぐりした人物。頭と肩に淡い金属の帯を着け、赤いマントを羽織る。

Field appearance mo_ff3_p008_c00.en: A slim red-clad figure nearly hides its face behind a hood and scarf. A pale eye stripe, dark seams and a red dangling trail show.
Field appearance mo_ff3_p008_c00.ja: 赤い服を着た細身の人物。顔のほとんどを頭巾とスカーフで覆い、淡い目元の帯、暗い縫い目、赤い垂れ布が見える。

Field appearance mo_ff3_p009_c00.en: A short pale fighter with swept light brown hair wears a blue outfit and cape with pale blue sleeves and gold trim.
Field appearance mo_ff3_p009_c00.ja: 流した淡い茶髪を持つ背の低い色白の戦士。青い服とマントに淡青の袖と金の縁がある。

Field appearance mo_ff3_p010_c00.en: A compact pale figure wears a broad red-marked white hood, a draping white coat and a red front panel.
Field appearance mo_ff3_p010_c00.ja: 色白の小柄な人物。赤い模様のある幅広い白頭巾に、垂れる白い上着と赤い前当てを着ける。

Field appearance mo_ff3_p011_c00.en: A large white hood has tall catlike ears lined in red. Brown hair frames large dark eyes. Red and gold clothes show beneath a white cape, with more of the red and gold front visible in battle.
Field appearance mo_ff3_p011_c00.ja: 大きな白頭巾に内側が赤い猫のような高い耳が付く。茶髪が大きく暗い目を囲む。白マントの下に赤と金の服があり、戦闘では赤金の前面がよく見える。

Field appearance mo_ff3_p012_c00.en: A blue pointed hood and cloak enclose a dark face with bright eyes. A crescent-shaped gold mark sits prominently on the hat and a gold band trims the robe.
Field appearance mo_ff3_p012_c00.ja: 青い尖り頭巾と外套が、光る目の暗い顔を囲む。帽子に目立つ金の三日月があり、ローブに金の帯がある。

Field appearance mo_ff3_p013_c00.en: A pale figure has straight white hair and wears a bright red academic coat with white panels and gold trim.
Field appearance mo_ff3_p013_c00.ja: 色白で白い直毛。白い布と金縁で飾る鮮赤の学士服を着ける。

Field appearance mo_ff3_p014_c00.en: A pointed green hat has a slim white feather above swept brown hair. A narrow green top and leggings cover pale limbs, with brown gloves or boots. Battle Ready shows the figure bracing with arms out.
Field appearance mo_ff3_p014_c00.ja: 流した茶髪の上に細い白羽根の付いた緑の尖り帽子。淡い手足を細身の緑の上着と脚衣が覆い、茶色の手袋か長靴を着ける。戦闘では腕を広げて構える。

Field appearance mo_ff3_p015_c00.en: A dark face has narrow yellow eyes under a thick blue hood with a gold folded border. A roomy blue robe covers the body.
Field appearance mo_ff3_p015_c00.ja: 金色の折り返し縁がある厚い青頭巾。暗い顔に細い黄色の目があり、体をゆったりした青いローブが包む。

Field appearance mo_ff3_p016_c00.en: Dark violet plate and a horned silver-accented helmet cover most of the figure. The chin and eyes show through small openings.
Field appearance mo_ff3_p016_c00.ja: 濃紫の板金鎧と銀で飾った角兜が体の大半を覆う。小さな開口部から顎と目が見える。

Field appearance mo_ff3_p017_c00.en: A blue helmet with large pale side horns shades two yellow eyes above a rust-colored beard or face guard. The field outfit is green and brown, and the battle sprite adds orange and gold cuffs and thick brown boots.
Field appearance mo_ff3_p017_c00.ja: 大きな淡色の横角付きの青兜が二つの黄色い目を覆う。下にさび色のひげか顔当てがある。野外の装いは緑と茶で、戦闘では橙と金の袖口と厚い茶の長靴が加わる。

Field appearance mo_ff3_p018_c00.en: A pale face has flowing brown hair with a little pointed green feather and a bright green tunic. Battle shows a leafy collar, green bands around the limbs and longer hair trailing while ready.
Field appearance mo_ff3_p018_c00.ja: 淡い顔に流れる茶髪と小さく尖った緑の羽根があり、鮮やかな緑の上着を着ける。戦闘では葉のような襟と手足の緑の帯が見え、構えると長い髪がなびく。

Field appearance mo_ff3_p019_c00.en: A blue full helm has a red eye slit and a pale gold plume. Blue layered plate, dark boots and gold edging cover the figure.
Field appearance mo_ff3_p019_c00.ja: 青い全頭兜に赤い目穴と淡金の羽根飾りがある。青く重なる板金鎧と暗い長靴、金の縁取りが体を覆う。

Field appearance mo_ff3_p020_c00.en: A small light-haired figure has a pointed forelock, green robe with gold edges and green boots.
Field appearance mo_ff3_p020_c00.ja: 小柄で髪は淡く、前髪の先が尖る。金で縁取った緑のローブと緑の長靴を着ける。

Field appearance mo_ff3_p021_c00.en: A fair-haired figure has a small pale forehead horn and a flowing green robe. The pale green ornament at its chest and the broad edge of the cloak are more defined in the battle view.
Field appearance mo_ff3_p021_c00.ja: 淡い髪に小さな淡色の額角があり、流れる緑のローブを着ける。戦闘姿では胸の淡緑の飾りと幅広いマントの縁がはっきりする。

Field appearance mo_ff3_p022_c00.en: A compact warrior wears rounded red headgear with a pale plume, a short red armored outfit with gold highlights and a white cape. Large eyes peer out from under the helmet.
Field appearance mo_ff3_p022_c00.ja: 小柄な戦士。淡い羽根が付いた丸いかぶり物、金で飾った短い鎧、白いマントを着ける。兜の下から大きな目がのぞく。かぶり物と鎧は赤。

Field appearance mo_ff3_p022_c01.en: A compact warrior wears rounded blue headgear with a pale plume, a short blue armored outfit with gold highlights and a white cape. Large eyes peer out from under the helmet.
Field appearance mo_ff3_p022_c01.ja: 小柄な戦士。淡い羽根が付いた丸いかぶり物、金で飾った短い鎧、白いマントを着ける。兜の下から大きな目がのぞく。かぶり物と鎧は青。

Field appearance mo_ff3_p022_c02.en: A compact warrior wears rounded green headgear with a pale plume, a short green armored outfit with gold highlights and a white cape. Large eyes peer out from under the helmet.
Field appearance mo_ff3_p022_c02.ja: 小柄な戦士。淡い羽根が付いた丸いかぶり物、金で飾った短い鎧、白いマントを着ける。兜の下から大きな目がのぞく。かぶり物と鎧は緑。

Field appearance mo_ff3_p022_c03.en: A compact warrior wears rounded pink headgear with a pale plume, a short pink armored outfit with gold highlights and a white cape. Large eyes peer out from under the helmet.
Field appearance mo_ff3_p022_c03.ja: 小柄な戦士。淡い羽根が付いた丸いかぶり物、金で飾った短い鎧、白いマントを着ける。兜の下から大きな目がのぞく。かぶり物と鎧は桃色。

Field appearance mo_ff3_v002_c00.en: A little black and brown hull has gold trim, a pale mast and a pointed bow.
Field appearance mo_ff3_v002_c00.ja: 黒と茶の小さな船体に金の縁取り。淡色の帆柱と尖った船首が付く。

Field appearance mo_ff3_v003_c00.en: A small craft with pale curved sails or panels has a gold-brown hull above gray-blue marks.
Field appearance mo_ff3_v003_c00.ja: 小型の船に湾曲した淡色の帆か板がある。青灰色の模様の上に金褐色の船体が浮く。

Field appearance mo_ff3_v004_c00.en: A low gold-rimmed vessel has a broad open dark deck and several short pale fittings.
Field appearance mo_ff3_v004_c00.ja: 金の縁がある低い船。幅広く暗い開放甲板と、淡い短い金具がいくつか見える。

Field appearance mo_ff3_v005_c00.en: A low wooden craft has a long sharp pale sail, orange-brown deck and narrow yellow rim.
Field appearance mo_ff3_v005_c00.ja: 低い木造の船。淡い細長い尖り帆と橙褐色の甲板、細い黄色の縁がある。

Field appearance mo_ff3_v006_c00.en: A small rounded copper and yellow craft has a short bright stem above it and a few pale marks at its side.
Field appearance mo_ff3_v006_c00.ja: 銅色と黄色の小さな丸い船。上に短く明るい棒が立ち、脇に淡い模様がいくつかある。

Field appearance mo_ff3_v007_c00.en: A broad ornate vessel has dark slats, several tall fittings and bright fiery orange and yellow trim on the sides.
Field appearance mo_ff3_v007_c00.ja: 装飾の多い幅広の船。暗いすのこ状の板と背の高い金具がいくつもあり、側面に炎のような鮮やかな橙と黄色の縁が走る。

Field appearance mo_ff3_v102_c00.en: A small rounded dark craft with a bronze edge has two blue-violet side pieces and pale trim.
Field appearance mo_ff3_v102_c00.ja: 青銅色の縁がある小さく丸い暗色の船。両脇に青紫の突起と淡色の縁取りがある。

Field appearance mo_ff4_n120_c03.en: A tiny dark green frog has gold eye and mouth highlights and thin bent legs.
Field appearance mo_ff4_n120_c03.ja: 濃緑の小さなカエル。目と口元に金色の光沢があり、細い脚を曲げる。

Weapon appearance wp_ff2_pu00_c00.en: A tan, clenched fist has a blue cuff.
Weapon appearance wp_ff2_pu00_c00.ja: 薄茶色の握り拳に青い袖口が付く。

Weapon appearance wp_ff3_ax01_c00.en: A double-edged axe has a short red haft and faceted gray-green blades with pale edges.
Weapon appearance wp_ff3_ax01_c00.ja: 短い赤い柄の両刃斧。面のある緑灰色の両刃に淡い縁がある。

Weapon appearance wp_ff3_ax02_c00.en: A long silver axe shaft supports two small dark olive crescent blades with yellow edges.
Weapon appearance wp_ff3_ax02_c00.ja: 長い銀の柄に、黄色い縁のある小さな濃いオリーブ色の三日月刃が二枚付く。

Weapon appearance wp_ff3_bk00_c00.en: A square red book has a black edge, a pale page stripe and dark trim.
Weapon appearance wp_ff3_bk00_c00.ja: 正方形の赤い本。黒い外縁と淡い紙の筋、暗色の縁飾りがある。

Weapon appearance wp_ff3_bk01_c00.en: A square blue book has a black edge, a pale page stripe and dark trim.
Weapon appearance wp_ff3_bk01_c00.ja: 正方形の青い本。黒い外縁と淡い紙の筋、暗色の縁飾りがある。

Weapon appearance wp_ff3_bk02_c00.en: A square gold book has a black edge, a pale page stripe and dark trim.
Weapon appearance wp_ff3_bk02_c00.ja: 正方形の金色の本。黒い外縁と淡い紙の筋、暗色の縁飾りがある。

Weapon appearance wp_ff3_bk03_c00.en: A square red tome has a dark edge, pale pages and an angular ring of red-gold markings.
Weapon appearance wp_ff3_bk03_c00.ja: 正方形の赤い大冊。外縁が暗く紙は淡色で、赤金色の模様が角張った輪を描く。

Weapon appearance wp_ff3_bk04_c00.en: A square blue tome has a dark edge, pale pages and an angular ring of light blue markings.
Weapon appearance wp_ff3_bk04_c00.ja: 正方形の青い大冊。外縁が暗く紙は淡色で、淡青色の模様が角張った輪を描く。

Weapon appearance wp_ff3_bk05_c00.en: A square gold tome has a dark edge, pale pages and an angular ring of pale yellow markings.
Weapon appearance wp_ff3_bk05_c00.ja: 正方形の金色の大冊。外縁が暗く紙は淡色で、淡黄色の模様が角張った輪を描く。

Weapon appearance wp_ff3_bw00_c01.en: A short upright bow has copper-red edges and a taut white string.
Weapon appearance wp_ff3_bw00_c01.ja: 縦に構えた短い弓。縁は赤銅色で、白い弦が張る。

Weapon appearance wp_ff3_bw00_c02.en: A short upright bow is plum and wine-colored, with a taut white string.
Weapon appearance wp_ff3_bw00_c02.ja: 縦に構えた短い弓。すもも色とワイン色で、白い弦が張る。

Weapon appearance wp_ff3_bw00_c03.en: A short upright bow has a yellow and pale turquoise curve and a taut white string.
Weapon appearance wp_ff3_bw00_c03.ja: 縦に構えた短い弓。黄色と淡い青緑に曲がり、白い弦が張る。

Weapon appearance wp_ff3_cw00_c00.en: Pointed pale blue claws extend from a dark gray knuckle guard with large gold fittings.
Weapon appearance wp_ff3_cw00_c00.ja: 大きな金の金具の付いた暗灰色の拳当てから、淡青色の尖った爪が伸びる。

Weapon appearance wp_ff3_ha00_c01.en: A narrow lyre has tall gold and green curved posts, a rounded base and straight pale strings.
Weapon appearance wp_ff3_ha00_c01.ja: 細身の竪琴。金と緑の支柱が高く曲がり、丸い台座に淡色のまっすぐな弦が張る。

Weapon appearance wp_ff3_ha00_c02.en: A narrow lyre is carved in dark violet and gray, with tall curved posts, a rounded base and straight pale strings.
Weapon appearance wp_ff3_ha00_c02.ja: 暗い紫と灰色の彫りのある細身の竪琴。高く曲がる支柱と丸い台座、淡いまっすぐな弦がある。

Weapon appearance wp_ff3_hm00_c01.en: A short deep blue shaft supports a split blue and white metal head with a bright cyan end.
Weapon appearance wp_ff3_hm00_c01.ja: 短い濃青色の柄に、青白に分かれた金属頭が付く。端は鮮やかな水色。

Weapon appearance wp_ff3_mo00_c00.en: Two orange-gold sticks are joined by a short dark segment.
Weapon appearance wp_ff3_mo00_c00.ja: 二本の橙金色の棒が短い暗色の部分でつながる。

Weapon appearance wp_ff3_mo01_c00.en: A gray and lilac bar has a short black side handle.
